function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT account_code, period, SUM(amount_cad) AS total_cad FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.gl_balance WHERE account_type='opex' AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09') GROUP BY account_code, period","purpose":"Check all OPEX accounts for Aug and Sep 2026"}
